rule_outs: Dwelling 5 m from the best section
summary: Steep 19 m kerb with houses 5-8 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses 5, 6 and 8 m from the kerb along its length.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street, the stretch is barely a van length and sits on a steep rise.
drivers.convention: Cars park further along the street but not on this short steep stub.

sun_shade: Mostly open; garden trees on the east side.
